name: uf_dryness_interop
description: Interop check against Uncompromising Fires (Fuu.UncompromisingFires, Workshop 2623963630), which transpiles the same WeatherManager.DoWeatherGUI seam we do to append its map-dryness readout to the weather label. Must be run twice from the same scenario file with the SAME mod set — once without --mod-overlay (main's Prefix replacement, where the dryness readout is absent) and once with it (the transpiler, where both readouts show) — because the thing under test is whether another mod's contribution survives ours, which no probe of ours can see. hideUi is false on purpose: the weather panel IS the measurement here, so the capture has to carry the HUD. The two Wait steps clear Uncompromising Fires' own 57-frame label-refresh gate; without them its guiDrynessLabel is still null and an inert capture would look identical to a broken one.
